scope: Recheck Terra setup, pending-worker completion, and current-call state review. Mirrored notification cleanup excluded.

evidence: MacContinuity.swift:100-105 sets confirmed = true before the invocation == returned guard.
If finish observes executing, confirm returns false but leaves confirmed true.
BluetoothCallController.swift:610-619 then marks the worker returned and calls invocationReturned; MacContinuity.swift:107-111 accepts confirmed and clears the operation.
If finish observes returned, confirm clears the operation directly.
correction.conclusion: The worker-return ordering does not leave setup busy by itself. The prior Terra audit treated the intermediate false return from confirm as terminal and was incorrect.

reviewedPaths.finding: Explicit setup blocks stale, busy, blocked, mismatched-peer, and active-call state; catalog results use canonical address deduplication, unique exact-name selection, chooser fallback, native HFP validation, one association commit, and connect.
Catalog completion is retained until operation completion; the corrected gate sequence permits finish before or after worker return.
Pending call actions require matching generation/context and documented native observations; call, SCO, and disconnect callbacks update current state through the owned HFP device check.
Current-call state keeps HFP context separate from mirrored notifications, rejects uncertain or waiting-call actions, and records SCO as connected-but-unverified.
Fresh pairing commits the ordinary association before guarded deferred call setup; the continuation checks current pairing, lifetime, device, session, and name.
